description: The Groz Cross Wheel Wrench is engineered for professionals and vehicle owners who need maximum torque with minimal effort. Crafted from premium EN8 steel and finished with a rust-resistant chrome plating, this wrench is designed to withstand heavy use. It is heat treated to a hardness of 38–50 HRC, ensuring a long service life even under demanding conditions. With four socket heads (17mm, 19mm, 21mm, 22mm), it fits most standard lug nuts, making it a versatile tool for cars, SUVs, and light trucks. Perfect for workshops, service units, tire shops, and personal toolkits, the Groz Cross Wheel Wrench combines durability, strength, and reliability in one essential tool.
